title: Smart Data Models - DataProvider
description: A technical agent (ETL, connector, ingestion service) that injects DigitalAssetMetric observations into the data space. Decoupled from Organization so that the same metric for the same channel on the same day can be supplied by multiple providers (e.g. an internal pipeline and a third-party agency) and remain distinguishable in the historic.

type.description: Property. NGSI Entity type. It has to be DataProvider.

providerKind.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Optional classification of the provider's relationship with the brand owner. 'Internal' = pipeline operated by the same Organization that owns the Brand. 'External' = an independent third party. 'Agency' = a marketing agency operating on behalf of the brand. 'Self' = the SaaS itself (e.g. Google sending raw data). Enum:'Internal, External, Agency, Self, Other'

version.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Text'. Version or release identifier of the provider's pipeline/connector. Useful for reproducibility when two versions of the same provider co-exist

url.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. URL of the provider's service or documentation

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

refOrganization.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. URN of the Organization that LEGALLY OWNS the data emitted by this provider. In a sovereign data space this is typically the same Organization that owns the Brand (canonical Internal case)

anyOf.description: Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Property. Identifier format of any NGSI entity

refOperator.description: Relationship. Model:'https://schema.org/URL'. URN of the Organization that TECHNICALLY OPERATES the pipeline (executes the ETL, owns the credentials, runs the connector). Optional: omit when operator equals owner (refOrganization). Use it to make explicit a delegation, e.g. an integrator running the pipeline on behalf of the data owner
